_source: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries (public domain, naturalearthdata.com), through world-atlas@2.0.2 countries-50m.json (ISC licence, Mike Bostock); ISO 3166 codes and English names from i18n-iso-countries@7.11.0 (MIT). Northern Cyprus is drawn with CY, Somaliland with SO, Ashmore and Cartier Islands with AU, Kosovo as XK/XKX; Antarctica, Siachen Glacier and the Indian Ocean Territories are left out. A country too small to keep its outline is a diamond of 3 units round its middle.
_projection: Natural Earth I: x = (x(lon) + 2.7354) * 1000, y = (1.4224 - y(lat)) * 1000, rounded
_format: code => [ alpha-3, name, other names, [ x0, y0, x1, y1 ], path, path simplified for a whole-world view ] - paths in relative coordinates, Douglas-Peucker at 0.8 and 4 units
